title: oplismenus walteri
intro: Oplismenus walteri, commonly known as Walter's false pheasant's tail, is a species of grass-like flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Oplismenus walteri include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
